mandatoryCriteria: Owner removal authority: Workspace owner can remove any project member (manager, member, viewer) across workspace projects via DELETE /api/v1/projects/:projectId/members/:userId
Project Manager removal limits: Project Manager can remove member and viewer roles only; attempting to remove a manager or owner returns 403 FORBIDDEN
Self-protection: Project Manager cannot remove themselves via DELETE /members/:userId (must use leave route); returns 403 FORBIDDEN
Status transition: Transition updates project_memberships.status to 'removed' and increments version; physical row is preserved for referential integrity and audit history
Immediate access revocation: Revocation takes effect immediately; subsequent requests by the removed member to project resources return 404 NOT_FOUND
R2 & R3 Audit compliance: Removed member cannot reuse unexpired invitations to restore access; write lock protocol rejects operations for actors with 'removed' status
Sibling project privacy: Outsiders and non-members receive 404 NOT_FOUND
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: DELETE /api/v1/projects/:projectId/members/:userId endpoint, role-based removal authorization, 'removed' status transition, version incrementing, and immediate access cut-off on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Voluntary member departure is covered by INV-08.
